en.headline: Alice Mak says Care Teams now key part of district governance
en.dek: The Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs told a training session for team leaders that the Care Teams, together with District Councils and the three committees, form the “three carriages” of local governance after…
body: Secretary for Home and Youth Affairs Alice Mak said on Thursday that Care Teams have become an important part of the government’s improved district governance structure.

Speaking at a training class for Care Team leaders and deputy leaders held at government headquarters, Ms Mak said the teams are not only providers of community care services but also members of the district governance team. After three years, they form the “three carriages” of local governance together with District Councils and the three committees.

District officers from Eastern and Tsuen Wan, together with Care Team representatives, shared experience of handling a wartime bomb evacuation in Quarry Bay and a power outage at Tsuen Wan Centre. The Home and Youth Affairs Bureau said it would continue to strengthen training covering emergency response and health support.

zh.headline: 麥美娟：關愛隊已成地區治理重要一環
zh.dek: 民政及青年事務局局長在關愛隊培訓班表示，關愛隊成立三年已成為完善地區治理架構重要部分，與區議會及「三會」組成「三駕馬車」。
body: 民政及青年事務局局長麥美娟周四表示，關愛隊已成為政府完善地區治理架構的重要一環。
她在政府總部舉行的關愛隊隊長及副隊長培訓班致辭時強調，關愛隊不只是社區關愛服務提供者，更是地區治理團隊的一份子。成立三年以來，關愛隊與區議會及「三會」組成地區治理的「三駕馬車」。
東區及荃灣區民政專員連同關愛隊代表分別分享處理鰂魚涌濱海街戰時炸彈疏散及荃灣中心停電事件的經驗。當局表示會繼續加強培訓，涵蓋應急知識及健康支援等實用課程。
